title: YEEZY QUANTUM
description: The adidas Yeezy Quantum ‘Frozen Blue’ applies a burst of color to Kanye West’s basketball-inspired mid-top. The layered upper features a bright blue RPU cage atop a jacquard knit upper, reinforced with synthetic suede at the toe cap. Black neoprene on the collar and tongue offers stretchy comfort, while a seamless heel counter is good for improved stability. Lightweight cushioning arrives via a Boost midsole reinforced with a semi-translucent TPU cage and a herringbone traction outsole underfoot.

title: YEEZY BOOST 350 V2 INFANT
description: The adidas Yeezy Boost 350 V2 Infant ‘Yeshaya’ utilizes a simple grey and white color scheme on the breathable knit upper, rendered in different woven patterns for a patchwork-like effect. The same dual tones are applied to the heavy rope laces and signature monofilament side stripe, adding a see-through element to the lightweight design. A full-length Boost midsole, encased in pale yellow semi-translucent rubber, delivers a cushioned ride.

title: YEEZY 450
description: The adidas Yeezy 450 ‘Dark Slate’ delivers a blacked-out iteration of Kanye West’s boundary-pushing silhouette. Stripped of color and exterior branding, the knit upper is secured with an integrated lacing system and topped with an elastic, sock-like cuff. In lieu of a traditional midsole, the rubber outsole sprouts tapered appendages that wrap up the heel and side panels of the deconstructed build, providing support and enhanced durability within its grasp.

title: YEEZY FOAM RUNNER
description: The adidas Yeezy Foam Runner ‘Sulfur’ showcases a yellowish beige hue throughout the one-piece EVA foam build, featuring strategically placed vents throughout the vamp and side panels for maximum breathability. Inside the slip-on, the footbed is equipped with a textured surface that prevents the foot from slipping. Branding is limited to ‘FOAM RNNR’ debossed on the interior collar and an adidas logo on the contoured outsole, featuring a wavy traction pattern for optimal grip.
